newsitem.title: GERMANY: D.Babcock to halve pre-tax loss in '96/97.
newsitem.headline: D.Babcock to halve pre-tax loss in '96/97.

text.p: German plant engineering group Deutsche Babcock AG said on Tuesday it expected to halve its pre-tax loss in the current business year and break even in 1997/98.
The company made a pre-tax loss of 400 million marks in the 1995/96 business year which ended last September 30.
D.Babcock to halve pre-tax loss in '96/97
The company said it saw incoming orders rising to 9.6 billion marks in 1996/97, and 10.3 billion the following from 8.4 billion marks last year.
Sales are expected to rise to 9.6 billion marks this year and 9.9 billion marks next year from 8.7 billion marks last year.
The workforce, meanwhile, is seen declining to 28,500 this year and 28,000 next year from 32,300 at the of the 1995/96 business year.
The company plans to invest 150 million marks both this year and next, down from 195 million marks in the year which has ended.

Deutsche Babcock earlier announced figures for the first four months of the current business year which showed that it had trimmed its group net loss by 100 million marks from last year's 250 million marks deficit. The company said it was in line with its financial forecasts.
